name: SetFocusOnElement
label: Set Focus on UI Element
description: Brings the specified UI element into focus, allowing further interaction.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element to bring into focus.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: IsFocued
fields.label: Is Focus Set Successfully
fields.description: True if the focus was set successfully, otherwise false.
